The '''Grade III battle station''' was a type of military [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was in use by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

==Characteristics==
[[Battle station/Legends|Battle stations]] of this kind were ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] wide, and equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. The large, prow-mounted heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons of a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] were capable of piercing the shields of a Grade III battle station.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
